name: harvest-new-project-to-zapier-table

deploy.description: New Harvest project -> upsert its row (project_id, client_id, is_active, Name) in the Harvest Projects (New) Zapier Table 01K8A2KV9X1W95GAB6Y69D7G4C, keyed on project_id. Never writes Project Page ID. Migrated from the classic Zap 'Add Harvest Project to Zapier Table'.

trigger.trigger_note: Polling trigger on the official Harvest app, one event per project id — a 'new' trigger, so the durable polling-dedupe bug (CLAUDE.md) does not bite. A manual `run-action HarvestCLIAPI read new_project` returns `[]`, so the payload shape is taken from the classic Zap's mappings (`record_id`, `client.id`, `is_active`, `name`); the code also accepts the plain API shape (`id`, `client_id`).

connections_note: No connection alias: the workflow only calls Zapier Tables. The trigger authenticates with the Harvest connection 02df9d5d-89ea-8dab-bb40-8ee0c2ac4362 ("Harvest dennis@work.flowers : Company Flow Pte. Ltd."), the same one the timer Zaps bind.

connectionless_apps.TableCLIAPI: find_record / create_record / update_record — no connection, no task cost

tables.01K8A2KV9X1W95GAB6Y69D7G4C: Harvest Projects (New) — f1 project_id, f2 client_id, f3 is_active, f4 Name, f5 Project Page ID. f5 is maintained by hand outside this repo and is never written by these Zaps; update_record leaves omitted columns alone (verified 2026-09-30).

classic_zap.title: Add Harvest Project to Zapier Table
classic_zap.note: The classic Zap created a row blindly on every event. This one finds by project_id first and updates instead, so a replay or a re-delivered project cannot duplicate a row.
